unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U05: Identify pledge,constructive delivery and limited security interest

payload.title: The pledgee holds a security interest, not unrestricted ownership
payload.core_explanation_md:
A pledge is the described bailment of goods as security for payment or performance. Identify the goods and the actual or constructive delivery of possession. General ownership remains with the pawnor while the pawnee has the relevant special security interest. Retaining custody with the debtor for a specific purpose needs its actual legal facts; it is not a universal rule that a pledge needs no possession.

A limited-interest pledgor cannot normally convey a larger interest merely by naming a larger loan. Re-pledge likewise needs the applicable limits and a valid underlying interest. An ineffective original pledge is not automatically cured by another transfer of the same goods.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a pledge automatically make the pawnee absolute owner?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Security and general ownership are different interests.

payload.stem_md: A pledge file describes the goods as the bank unrestricted property from the moment of pledge. Which distinction is needed?

options.text_md: Every security is a completed sale
options.explanation_md: A pledge is not automatically a sale.

options.text_md: The pawnee special security interest differs from general ownership
options.explanation_md: The source preserves the pawnor general property.

options.text_md: The debt must be ignored because goods exist
options.explanation_md: Security supports the obligation rather than eliminating it.

options.text_md: A custody label alone proves every legal delivery fact

payload.correct_explanation_md: The source preserves the pawnor general property.

payload.stem_md: A party with only a limited established interest purports to pledge unrestricted ownership. What must be examined?

options.text_md: The declared larger loan automatically expands title
options.explanation_md: Loan size does not create ownership.

options.text_md: Any later pledge cures every original defect
options.explanation_md: A defective original interest cannot be assumed cured.
That does not establish title scope.

options.text_md: The actual interest and statutory limits on what can be pledged
options.explanation_md: The transfer cannot be assessed without that legal extent.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The transfer cannot be assessed without that legal extent.
